pages.text: Higher essence isn't crafted here. It's brewed in a $(l:crafting/create#crafting_kinetics_mechanical_press)Create mixer$(/l): four of one tier around an $(l:magic/mystical#mystical_prosperity_seed_base)Infusion Crystal$(/l) make four of the next. Each mix spends one of the crystal's 500 uses, and the mixer hands the crystal back with the essence.

Supremium and Insanium need the $(l:magic/mystical2#mystical_machine_frame)Master Infusion Crystal$(/l), which never wears out. It takes Imperium and a Nether Star. Imperium and Supremium need a heated mixer; Insanium needs a superheated one.
The $(l:magic/mystical2#mystical_machine_frame)Machine Frame$(/l) is Create brass. The $(l:magic/mystical2#mystical_awakening_altar)Awakening Altar$(/l) needs Ignitium.$(br2)Insanium ends the climb.

Two $(l:magic/mystical2#insanium_gear_insanium_chestplate)Insanium Ingots$(/l) and two $(l:magic/mystical2#insanium_gear_insanium_chestplate)Insanium Gemstones$(/l) around a piece of Awakened Supremium gear make its $(l)Mystical Adaptations$() Insanium version, the strongest armor and tools in the mod.
The piece keeps its enchantments, gems, quality, augments and name. Kill the Wither or the Ender Dragon with an Insanium weapon and it drops Insanium Essence.

Every tier also makes an $(l:magic/mystical2#mystical_staff_inferium_staff)Essence Staff$(/l). Here they are spell staves: they hit hard, raise spell power and mana regeneration, and hold imbued spells, one at Inferium and four at Insanium. Put a scroll on one at an Arcane Anvil to imbue it; each scroll fills the next slot.
Grown, not mixed: Inferium crops drop it. Every tier above starts here.

pages.title: Prudentium Essence
pages.text: Four Inferium round an Infusion Crystal, in any mixer. One crystal use per four essence.

pages.title: Tertium Essence
pages.text: Four Prudentium round an Infusion Crystal, in any mixer. One crystal use per four essence.

pages.title: Imperium Essence
pages.text: Four Tertium round an Infusion Crystal, heated. One crystal use per four essence.

pages.title: Supremium Essence
pages.text: Four Imperium round the Master Crystal, heated. It never wears out.

pages.title: Insanium Essence
pages.text: Four Supremium round the Master Crystal, superheated with a Blaze Cake.
